subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of A. Only three people sit between A and Y. L. sits second to the right of A. Only two people sit between L and Z. C sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of X.

How many people sit to the right of C?
solution: Given, Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of A. Only three people sit between A and Y. L sits second to the right of A.
